g.title: uart_rx
g.text: UART Receiver (RX): what happens on every clock tick
Each time you come back to the top of a coloured box = one clock later. N = clocks per bit.

g.title: cluster_front
g.text: Always on: the "airlock" (runs every clock, in parallel)

g.title: cluster_idle
g.text: IDLE — waiting for someone to talk

g.title: cluster_start
g.text: START — is it a real start bit or just noise?

g.title: cluster_data
g.text: DATA — collect 8 bits, one every N clocks

g.title: cluster_stop
g.text: STOP — check the frame ended properly

g.title: fallw
g.text: fall = rx_prev is 1 AND rx_sync is 0

g.title: s_q
g.text: Reached the MIDDLE of the start bit?

g.title: s_ok
g.text: every N clocks = middle of a bit)

g.title: d_smp
g.text: slide it into the byte from the top
